name: Document Desk
description: Keep your documents in one searchable library. Add PDF, Word, Markdown, web page, spreadsheet and text files, or share a folder and the library stays in step with it. Find passages by meaning, exact phrase or pattern, and read them as clean text.
author: Vakyartha

documents.reason: Document Desk keeps the files you add and the folders you share as searchable text.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.title: Search documents
tools.description: Search the person's own documents (contracts, policies, bills, notes, reports) kept in Document Desk. Start here for any question about what their papers say. mode smart (default) returns the best documents, each with its best passages, section and line; put a phrase that must appear in "quotes" and -word to leave documents out. mode exact finds lines containing the text; mode regex finds lines matching a regular expression. Narrow with document (one id), kind or tags. Read-only.

tools.name: get_document_outline
tools.title: Document outline
tools.description: One Document Desk document's outline: title, kind, pages, words, status, tags, every heading with its line (PDFs have a "Page n" heading per page), and the documents it links to or is linked from. Use it to find the right part of a long document before reading. Read-only.

tools.name: read_document
tools.title: Read a document
tools.description: Read about 12,000 characters of one Document Desk document as Markdown, starting at a section (heading text), a PDF page, a line (from a search result) or offsetLine. Returns the section it starts in; more says whether text continues, so read on with offsetLine = toLine + 1. Read-only.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List Document Desk documents with id, title, kind, pages, date, status and tags. Newest first by default; sort oldest or title. Narrow with kind, tag or words in the title (title). Use it for questions like "my latest bill" or "which policies do I have". Read-only.

skills.name: document-desk-reader
skills.description: Answer questions from the person's own documents in Document Desk: search, read the passage, and cite it.
